title: Restore role-owned Staging Gateway authority after schema-only recovery

phases.objective: Replay the exact Staging Activation Gateway authority metadata into its canonical Runtime and Governance ownership domains after schema-only local database recovery while preserving pending provider certification and every Production/provider boundary.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Recover-StagingDatabases.ps1 on an exact clean main checkout after role-aware schema import
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Runtime-owned authority requirement/route rows and Governance-owned apply-policy/resource-binding/certification rows are restored to their canonical databases; the exact Worker binding is visible through the existing Governance Authority Store routing boundary; dispatch certification remains pending and disabled; grant reconciliation proceeds afterward without provider or Production mutation.
steps: Build and import the existing role-aware schema-only Staging bundles.
Validate one canonical Gateway authority seed manifest whose Runtime and Governance seed files are independently SHA-256-bound and LF-pinned.

Preflight only platform_resource_authority_requirements and resource_authority_route_family_registry in Runtime, and only capability_apply_authorization_policy_registry, platform_resource_authority_bindings and runtime_dispatch_certification_registry in Governance.
Replay the two Runtime rows with local Runtime root and the three Governance rows with local Governance root, using idempotent INSERT/ON DUPLICATE statements only.
Perform exact same-cycle readback for authority identity, policy hash, resource binding and pending certification before recovery is allowed to continue to grant reconciliation.

Rely on the existing Activation Gateway rollout wrapper boundary that routes platform_resource_authority_bindings queries to the Governance Authority Store and preserves workspace/runtime reads on Runtime.
assertions: The profile binding 5a2b04f8-bb99-4f65-a924-0f55d3080376 is restored by the canonical recovery path rather than manual raw SQL.
platform_resource_authority_bindings, capability_apply_authorization_policy_registry and runtime_dispatch_certification_registry remain Governance-owned and Runtime-excluded.
Runtime authority requirement and route metadata are not incorrectly written into Governance DB.
The Staging apply policy remains bound to admin_cloudflare_v1, activation_gateway.staging_apply and policy hash c6468e051b8456d4d3ffc6478cdb98f7048b69c8ca6742f4dca27e1eb4023f32.
runtime_dispatch_certification_registry is forced to pending with dispatch_allowed=0 and apply_allowed=0 until independent same-cycle certification.
Neither seed contains GRANT, REVOKE, user/database DDL, external-data SQL, provider calls or secret payloads.
Both seed SQL files are pinned to LF so the reviewed SHA-256 values are stable on Windows checkout.
No Cloudflare, DNS, custom-domain, Hostinger or Production mutation is authorized by this change.
